title: Notice of Failure under KestrelCare: Late-Notice Share
content:
**Clause.** On a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts remainder authorization, a late-notice share applies to the amount payable after the deductible, counted in calendar days from the failure date on the repair order (as recorded on the Kestrel limited warranty decision) to the day of the decision:

- beyond 60 days (the late-notice days), the plan pays the late-notice share of 80 percent;
- beyond 30 days (the delayed-notice days) but not beyond 60 days, the plan pays the delayed-notice share of 90 percent;
- within 30 days, the plan pays the whole amount.

The share is applied before the comparison with the per-visit limit and the coverage remaining.

| Calendar days from failure date to decision | Share the plan pays |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | 100 percent |
| 31 to 60 | 90 percent |
| 61 or more | 80 percent |

*Hypothetical dates (non-leap year):* failure date 3 February, decision 5 March: 30 days, whole amount. Failure date 3 February, decision 6 March: 31 days, 90 percent. Failure date 3 February, decision 5 April: 61 days, 80 percent.
